title: The Well of Kindness
source_detail: Story of Prophet Yusuf and the well
description: A boy thrown into a well learns to forgive. Follow his journey as he discovers that letting go of anger brings freedom.

pages.text: Once upon a time, there was a gentle boy named Yusuf. He had many brothers who, one day, decided to play a trick on him. They led him to a deep, mysterious well.
pages.illustration_prompt: A serene countryside with lush green fields and a group of brothers leading a young boy toward a well. The sunset casts warm orange and pink hues across the sky, creating a magical atmosphere.

pages.text: Yusuf looked around, confused, as he stood at the edge of the well. His brothers whispered and giggled, but he didn’t understand their plan.
pages.illustration_prompt: Yusuf, a young boy with big, expressive cartoon eyes, stands near a well with his brothers. The well is surrounded by vibrant greenery, and the brothers are depicted in soft focus, whispering to one another.

pages.text: Suddenly, they pushed him gently, and he fell into the well. The darkness surrounded him, but he was not afraid. He knew he was not alone.
pages.illustration_prompt: Yusuf, depicted as a silhouette, falling gently into the well with a serene expression. Golden light bathes him as the well is shown with a deep blue interior, speckled with light reflections.

pages.text: In the well, Yusuf prayed to Allah. He believed that help would come, and his heart filled with patience and hope.
pages.illustration_prompt: Inside the well, a gentle golden light envelops Yusuf, who sits calmly with his hands raised in prayer. The deep blues of the well are softened by the warm glow, creating a peaceful setting.

pages.text: One day, a passing caravan stopped for water. They found Yusuf and pulled him out. The traders were kind and took him on their journey.
pages.illustration_prompt: A colorful caravan with camels is depicted near the well. Traders, with gentle expressions, are shown helping Yusuf out of the well. The scene is vibrant with sunset oranges and lush greenery.

pages.text: As the caravan traveled, Yusuf saw new lands and met many people. He never spoke of his brothers with anger, but instead with understanding.
pages.illustration_prompt: Yusuf sitting on a camel, looking out at a vibrant landscape of rolling hills and exotic plants. His expression is one of wonder and curiosity, with the caravan journeying behind him.

pages.text: Yusuf’s heart grew warm with each new friend he made. He realized that holding onto anger would only weigh him down.
pages.illustration_prompt: A warm scene of Yusuf surrounded by new friends from the caravan. They are smiling and sharing fruits under a tree, with the background painted in soft pinks and lush greens.

pages.text: Years passed, and Yusuf became a wise and respected man. He never forgot what happened, but he forgave his brothers.
pages.illustration_prompt: Yusuf, now older, is shown as a radiant silhouette in golden light, standing in a market full of vibrant colors and bustling activity. People around him are shown smiling and greeting him warmly.

pages.text: One day, Yusuf’s brothers came to him, asking for help. They did not recognize the wise man he had become.
pages.illustration_prompt: Yusuf’s brothers are depicted with humble expressions, approaching a grand, warm-lit hall where Yusuf stands as a silhouette, bathed in golden light, his features hidden.

pages.text: Instead of being angry, Yusuf chose kindness. He revealed himself to his brothers and embraced them with open arms.
pages.illustration_prompt: A touching scene of Yusuf embracing his brothers, who have tears of joy. The background is filled with soft, sunset oranges and pinks, creating a feeling of warmth and reconciliation.

pages.text: His brothers were amazed by Yusuf’s forgiveness. They realized the strength in letting go of past mistakes.
pages.illustration_prompt: Yusuf’s brothers, with expressions of awe and gratitude, look up to him. The setting is vibrant with lush greens and golden light, symbolizing the renewal and growth of their relationship.

pages.text: Yusuf taught them that forgiveness was like a gentle rain, washing away the sadness in their hearts.
pages.illustration_prompt: A scene showing light rain falling over a garden, with Yusuf and his brothers walking together. The rain creates a magical, vibrant setting with flowers blooming in rich colors.

pages.text: From that day on, Yusuf’s family was reunited. Love and peace filled their home, and they were never apart again.
pages.illustration_prompt: Yusuf’s family gathered around a table filled with food, smiling and sharing stories. The room is warmly lit with golden hues, creating a cozy, loving atmosphere.

pages.text: Every night, under the stars, Yusuf would tell his children about the power of forgiveness and kindness.
pages.illustration_prompt: Yusuf sitting under a starlit sky with his children around him, listening intently. The scene is peaceful with deep blues and twinkling stars, creating a magical night-time setting.

pages.text: His children learned that forgiving others brought them closer to Allah and made their hearts light.
pages.illustration_prompt: A dreamy scene of children playing in a lush garden under the moonlight. Their expressions are joyful, and the garden is full of vibrant flowers and soft, glowing lights.

pages.text: Yusuf felt grateful for his journey. He knew that kindness and forgiveness were gifts from Allah to be shared.
pages.illustration_prompt: Yusuf gazing at the night sky, reflecting with gratitude. The stars form a gentle, glowing pattern in the sky, and the landscape is painted with warm, inviting colors.

pages.text: As the years passed, Yusuf’s story became one of hope and inspiration for everyone who heard it.
pages.illustration_prompt: A diverse group of people, young and old, gathered around a storyteller under a large, leafy tree. The scene is vibrant and full of life, with Yusuf’s story being shared.

pages.text: The well that once held him captive became a symbol of the strength found in forgiveness and love.
pages.illustration_prompt: The well, overgrown with flowers and vines, stands as a beautiful, serene monument. It is surrounded by lush greenery and soft sunlight, symbolizing peace and growth.

pages.text: And so, Yusuf lived a life full of joy, teaching everyone around him the beauty of a forgiving heart.
pages.illustration_prompt: Yusuf, older and wise, is shown surrounded by family and friends in a warmly lit room. Their faces are filled with happiness, and the room is alive with vibrant colors and warmth.

pages.text: As you drift to sleep, remember Yusuf’s tale. Let go of any anger, and let your heart be light. Goodnight, dear child.
pages.illustration_prompt: A gentle night-time scene with a child in bed, cuddling a soft toy, looking peaceful and content. The room is softly lit with warm, golden light, and a window shows a starry night sky.
